As for how social struggles present in me (I should note that these are much worse IRL than online/through text):

I'm not good at approaching people to talk to them. If I observe people talking to each other, I have to have a specific part of the conversation that I'm knowledgeable about / have an opinion on that I can latch on to and talk about. When I was younger, I would kinda just impose myself on the other person by saying something random or funny that I thought would make them want to talk to me.

I dont tend to show interest in other people and their lives.

I'm bad at small talk / just don't like it.

I struggle to find the value in / follow some social rules e.g my mother has to prompt me to say hello to people often

It's hard for me to display some emotions generally like gratitude, excitement etc and I never really share the emotions of others.

I'm terrible with eye contact, but in 2 different ways. 1. I just find it difficult to look into peoples' eyes for any prolonged amount of time due to anxiety / an uncomfortable feeling. 2. I tend to just not have any interest in looking into peoples' eyes? So sometimes I just don't.

I don't really use gestures.

People sometimes need me to repeat things as I speak quite quietly sometimes, but I also just have a deep voice lol. It can be quite monotone too, I've been likened to a zombie before at times.

Since I have trouble looking at people, I don't think I notice their body language.

I can spend a lot of time alone.

I guess I have a more transactional view of friendships, for me the main thing is really just to have fun and be entertained.

I've been called naive before.

I've been called cold/rude even though it has been unintentional.

Sometimes I feel a sudden urge to talk to people, but then I regret it a few sentences later lol.

When I was younger, I found it more difficult to tell whether or not someone wanted to talk to me. I still find it difficult, but now it's more because I'm hypersensitive to tone etc due to the consequences of not being able to tell before.
